data.notes: The report correctly diagnoses value proof over price. It shows the champion asked for a one-page business case and got the deck, and that the decline analysis was declined. It also shows that the CFO saw a rate-only page with nothing from us but the quote. It never cites or labels the rep's closing claim 'If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this' as opinion, or shows his own T34 admission undercutting it. It also mislabels the Lucy-relayed fact 'No new product, nothing. Just a better rate.' as opinion.
